from solution import Service, GatewayTimeout


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.fail = 0

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        if self.fail:
            self.fail -= 1
            raise GatewayTimeout()


def make(user="alice"):
    clock, gw = Clock(), Gateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw)
    assert svc.register(user, "password1")[0] == 201
    return svc, clock, gw, svc.login(user, "password1")[1]["token"]


def tok(svc, user):
    svc.register(user, "password1")
    return svc.login(user, "password1")[1]["token"]


def test_register_validation():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("ab", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("Bob", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("bobby", "short")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("alice", "password1")[0] == 409


def test_token_expiry_and_logout():
    svc, clock, _, t = make()
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert svc.logout(t)[0] == 204
    assert svc.get_document(t, "doc-1")[0] == 401
    assert svc.logout(t)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(t2)[0] == 200
    clock.t += 3599
    assert svc.export_documents(t2)[0] == 200
    clock.t += 1
    assert svc.export_documents(t2)[0] == 401


def test_document_validation():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    assert svc.create_document(t, "", "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 201, "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 200, "x" * 100000)[0] == 201


def test_ownership():
    svc, _, _, a = make()
    b = tok(svc, "bobby")
    d = svc.create_document(a, "secret", "s")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.get_document(b, d)[0] == 404
    assert svc.update_document(b, d, "x", "y")[0] == 404
    assert svc.delete_document(b, d)[0] == 404
    assert svc.search_documents(b, "secret") == (200, [])
    assert svc.export_documents(b) == (200, [])
    assert svc.list_documents(b)[1]["items"] == []
    assert svc.get_document(a, d)[0] == 200


def test_pagination_with_deletes_and_creates():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    ids = [svc.create_document(t, "t%d" % i, "")[1]["id"] for i in range(5)]
    s, p = svc.list_documents(t, page_size=2)
    assert [d["id"] for d in p["items"]] == ids[:2]
    svc.delete_document(t, ids[2])
    svc.update_document(t, ids[3], "new", "new")
    new = svc.create_document(t, "later", "")[1]["id"]
    seen = [d["id"] for d in p["items"]]
    cur = p["next_cursor"]
    while cur:
        s, p = svc.list_documents(t, page_size=2, cursor=cur)
        assert s == 200
        seen += [d["id"] for d in p["items"]]
        cur = p["next_cursor"]
    assert seen == [ids[0], ids[1], ids[3], ids[4], new]


def test_cursor_and_page_size_errors():
    svc, _, _, a = make()
    b = tok(svc, "bobby")
    for i in range(3):
        svc.create_document(a, "t", "")
    cur = svc.list_documents(a, page_size=1)[1]["next_cursor"]
    assert svc.list_documents(b, cursor=cur)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(a, cursor="bogus")[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(a, page_size=0)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(a, page_size=101)[0] == 400


def test_search():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    svc.create_document(t, "Alpha", "x")
    svc.create_document(t, "b", "ALPHAbet")
    assert len(svc.search_documents(t, "alpha")[1]) == 2
    assert svc.search_documents(t, "")[0] == 400


def test_ids_not_reused():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    d1 = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(t, d1)
    d2 = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    assert d1 != d2


def test_payment_idempotency():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    s, p = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert s == 201
    s2, p2 = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert s2 == 200 and p2["id"] == p["id"]
    assert svc.pay(t, 200, "k")[0] == 409
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1
    b = tok(svc, "bobby")
    assert svc.pay(b, 200, "k")[0] == 201
    assert len(gw.charges) == 2


def test_payment_validation():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    assert svc.pay(t, 0, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1000001, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1.5, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(None, 5, "k")[0] == 401


def test_payment_timeout_retry():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    gw.fail = 1
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.list_payments(t) == (200, [])
    s, p = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert s in (200, 201)
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] == 200
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service
from gateway import GatewayTimeout


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += dt


class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; behavior script per call."""

    def __init__(self, script=None):
        self.script = list(script or [])
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = []

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        mode = self.script.pop(0) if self.script else "ok"
        if mode == "timeout_before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charged.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
        if mode == "timeout_after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents, "status": "charged"}


def make(ttl=3600, script=None):
    clock = FakeClock()
    gw = FakeGateway(script)
    return Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl), clock, gw


def user(svc, name="alice", pw="password1"):
    st_, _ = svc.register(name, pw)
    assert st_ == 201, f"input={name!r} output={st_!r}"
    s, b = svc.login(name, pw)
    assert s == 200, f"input={name!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    return b["token"]


def mk(svc, tok, title="t", content="c"):
    s, b = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert s == 201, f"input={(title, content)!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    return b["id"]


DOC_KEYS = {"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}
PAY_KEYS = {"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}
NAME_ALPHA = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_"
TEXT = st.text(alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_categories=("Cs",)), min_size=1, max_size=30)
ASCII = "abcXYZ 01"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-14

def test_register_username_length_boundaries():
    """Usernames of 3 to 32 characters are accepted and 2 or 33 characters are rejected with 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    for name, exp in [("ab", 400), ("abc", 201), ("a" * 32, 201), ("a" * 33, 400), ("", 400)]:
        out = svc.register(name, "password1")[0]
        assert out == exp, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["Abc", "ab-c", "ab c", "abc!", "ABC", "a.b"])
def test_register_username_invalid_characters(name):
    """A username with characters outside [a-z0-9_] is rejected with 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out = svc.register(name, "password1")[0]
    assert out == 400, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


def test_register_password_length_boundary():
    """A password of 7 characters is rejected with 400 and one of 8 characters is accepted."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    out7 = svc.register("user_a", "1234567")[0]
    out8 = svc.register("user_b", "12345678")[0]
    assert out7 == 400, f"input='1234567' output={out7!r}"
    assert out8 == 201, f"input='12345678' output={out8!r}"


def test_register_duplicate_is_409_and_keeps_password():
    """Registering an existing username returns 409 and does not change the original credentials."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("alice", "password1")[0] == 201
    out = svc.register("alice", "otherpass9")[0]
    assert out == 409, f"input='alice' output={out!r}"

    assert s_new == 401, f"input=new output={s_new!r}"


def test_rejected_registration_creates_no_user():

    svc, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.register("bob", "short")[0] == 400
    out = svc.login("bob", "short")[0]
    assert out == 401, f"input=('bob','short') output={out!r}"


def test_login_success_and_failures():
    """Login returns 200 with a string token for correct credentials and 401 for wrong password or unknown user."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    s, b = svc.login("alice", "password1")
    assert s == 200 and isinstance(b["token"], str), f"output={(s, b)!r}"
    out = svc.login("alice", "wrongpass1")[0]
    assert out == 401, f"input=wrong output={out!r}"
    out = svc.login("nobody", "password1")[0]
    assert out == 401, f"input=unknown output={out!r}"


def test_login_returns_new_token_each_time():
    """Each login returns a new token."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    toks = [svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"] for _ in range(4)]
    assert len(set(toks)) == 4, f"output={toks!r}"


def test_token_expiry_boundary_default_ttl():
    """A token is accepted just before created+3600 and rejected at exactly created+3600."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3599.5
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)[0]
    assert out == 200, f"now={clock.t!r} output={out!r}"
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3600.0
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)[0]
    assert out == 401, f"now={clock.t!r} output={out!r}"


def test_token_expiry_custom_ttl_and_relogin():
    """With token_ttl=10 a token is rejected from created+10 on, and a new login gives a working token."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=10)
    tok = user(svc)
    clock.t = 1009.5
    assert svc.export_documents(tok)[0] == 200
    clock.t = 1010.0
    out = svc.export_documents(tok)[0]
    assert out == 401, f"now={clock.t!r} output={out!r}"
    clock.t = 1500.0
    out = svc.export_documents(tok)[0]
    assert out == 401, f"now={clock.t!r} output={out!r}"
    tok2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    out = svc.export_documents(tok2)[0]
    assert out == 200, f"now={clock.t!r} output={out!r}"


def test_token_expiry_is_measured_from_creation_not_last_use():
    """Using a token does not extend its validity beyond created+token_ttl."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=10)
    tok = user(svc)
    clock.t = 1008.0
    assert svc.list_documents(tok)[0] == 200
    clock.t = 1010.0
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)[0]
    assert out == 401, f"now={clock.t!r} output={out!r}"


CALLS = {
    "logout": lambda s, t, d: s.logout(t),
    "create": lambda s, t, d: s.create_document(t, "t2", "c2"),
    "get": lambda s, t, d: s.get_document(t, d),
    "update": lambda s, t, d: s.update_document(t, d, "new", "new"),
    "delete": lambda s, t, d: s.delete_document(t, d),
    "list": lambda s, t, d: s.list_documents(t),
    "search": lambda s, t, d: s.search_documents(t, "t"),
    "export": lambda s, t, d: s.export_documents(t),
    "pay": lambda s, t, d: s.pay(t, 100, "k-auth"),
    "list_payments": lambda s, t, d: s.list_payments(t),
}


def _assert_untouched(svc, gw, owner_tok, doc_id):
    s, b = svc.get_document(owner_tok, doc_id)
    assert s == 200 and b["title"] == "t" and b["content"] == "c", f"output={(s, b)!r}"
    s, b = svc.export_documents(owner_tok)
    assert s == 200 and len(b) == 1, f"output={(s, b)!r}"
    s, b = svc.list_payments(owner_tok)
    assert s == 200 and b == [], f"output={(s, b)!r}"
    assert gw.charged == {}, f"charged={gw.charged!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(CALLS))
@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["missing", "unknown", "expired", "revoked"])
def test_invalid_token_gives_401_everywhere_without_side_effects(name, kind):
    """Every token-taking method returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or revoked token and has no effect."""
    svc, clock, gw = make(ttl=100)
    owner = user(svc, "owner_u")
    doc = mk(svc, owner)
    if kind == "missing":
        tok = None
    elif kind == "unknown":
        tok = "no-such-token"
    elif kind == "revoked":
        tok = svc.login("owner_u", "password1")[1]["token"]
        assert svc.logout(tok)[0] == 204
    else:
        tok = svc.login("owner_u", "password1")[1]["token"]
    if kind == "expired":
        clock.advance(100)
        owner = svc.login("owner_u", "password1")[1]["token"]
    out = CALLS[name](svc, tok, doc)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"method={name} token={tok!r} output={out!r}"
    _assert_untouched(svc, gw, owner, doc)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-15

def test_logout_revokes_only_that_token():
    """Logout returns 204, revokes that token, and leaves other tokens of the same user valid."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    t1 = user(svc)
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]

    """Logging out with an already revoked token returns 401."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    assert svc.logout(tok)[0] == 204
    out = svc.logout(tok)[0]

def test_create_document_and_get_roundtrip():
    """A created document is returned by get with its fields and created_at equal to clock.now() at creation."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    clock.t = 1234.5
    s, b = svc.create_document(tok, "Title", "Body")
    assert s == 201 and isinstance(b["id"], str), f"output={(s, b)!r}"
    clock.t = 2000.0

def test_create_title_and_content_boundaries():
    """Titles of 1..200 characters and contents of 0..100000 characters are accepted; 0/201 and 100001 give 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    cases = [
        ("", "c", 400), ("a", "c", 201), ("a" * 200, "c", 201), ("a" * 201, "c", 400),
        ("t", "", 201), ("t", "x" * 100000, 201), ("t", "x" * 100001, 400),
    ]
    for title, content, exp in cases:
        out = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)[0]
        assert out == exp, f"input={(len(title), len(content))!r} output={out!r}"


def test_rejected_create_stores_nothing():
    """A create rejected with 400 does not store a document."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    svc.create_document(tok, "", "c")
    out = svc.export_documents(tok)
    assert out == (200, []), f"output={out!r}"


@settings(deadline=None, max_examples=30)
@given(ops=st.lists(st.tuples(st.sampled_from(["a", "b"]), st.sampled_from(["create", "delete"])), max_size=30))
def test_ids_unique_and_never_reused(ops):
    """Document ids are unique across users and are never reused after deletion."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    toks = {"a": user(svc, "user_a"), "b": user(svc, "user_b")}
    alive = {"a": [], "b": []}
    seen = []
    for who, op in ops:
        if op == "create" or not alive[who]:
            i = mk(svc, toks[who])
            seen.append(i)
            alive[who].append(i)
        else:
            i = alive[who].pop(0)
            assert svc.delete_document(toks[who], i)[0] == 204
    assert len(set(seen)) == len(seen), f"input={ops!r} output={seen!r}"

def test_other_users_document_is_404_like_nonexistent():
    """A request by A on a document of B returns exactly the same response as for a nonexistent document."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    a, b = user(svc, "user_a"), user(svc, "user_b")
    bid = mk(svc, b, "secret", "secret")
    ghost = "nonexistent-id-xyz"
    pairs = [
        (svc.get_document(a, bid), svc.get_document(a, ghost)),
        (svc.update_document(a, bid, "x", "y"), svc.update_document(a, ghost, "x", "y")),
        (svc.delete_document(a, bid), svc.delete_document(a, ghost)),
    ]
    for got, exp in pairs:

    s, d = svc.get_document(b, bid)
    assert s == 200 and d["title"] == "secret" and d["content"] == "secret", f"output={(s, d)!r}"


@settings(deadline=None, max_examples=30)
@given(na=st.integers(0, 4), nb=st.integers(0, 4), ps=st.integers(1, 3))
def test_no_response_to_a_contains_documents_of_b(na, nb, ps):
    """No response to user A (get, list, search, export, update, delete) contains a document owned by B."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    a, b = user(svc, "user_a"), user(svc, "user_b")
    aids = {mk(svc, a, f"a{i}", "shared") for i in range(na)}
    bids = [mk(svc, b, f"b{i}", "shared") for i in range(nb)]
    for bid in bids:
        for out in (svc.get_document(a, bid), svc.update_document(a, bid, "x", "y"), svc.delete_document(a, bid)):
            assert out[0] == 404, f"input={bid!r} output={out!r}"
    returned = []
    cursor = None
    for _ in range(50):
        s, page = svc.list_documents(a, ps, cursor)
        assert s == 200, f"input={(ps, cursor)!r} output={(s, page)!r}"
        returned += page["items"]
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break
    s1, found = svc.search_documents(a, "shared")
    s2, exported = svc.export_documents(a)
    assert s1 == 200 and s2 == 200
    for label, docs in (("list", returned), ("search", found), ("export", exported)):
        ids = [d["id"] for d in docs]
        assert set(ids) == aids and len(ids) == len(set(ids)), f"method={label} output={docs!r}"
    for i, bid in enumerate(bids):
        s, d = svc.get_document(b, bid)
        assert s == 200 and d["title"] == f"b{i}", f"output={(s, d)!r}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- REQ-18

def test_update_document_fields_and_position():
    """Update returns 200 with the new title and content and keeps id and created_at."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok, "old", "old")
    clock.advance(500)
    s, d = svc.update_document(tok, doc_id, "new", "newer")
    assert s == 200, f"output={(s, d)!r}"
    assert (d["id"], d["title"], d["content"], d["created_at"]) == (doc_id, "new", "newer", 1000.0), f"output={d!r}"
    s, g = svc.get_document(tok, doc_id)
    assert g == d, f"output={g!r} expected={d!r}"


def test_update_validation_boundaries_and_no_change():
    """Update applies the same title and content limits as create and a 400 leaves the document unchanged."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok, "keep", "keep")
    for title, content, exp in [("", "c", 400), ("a" * 201, "c", 400), ("t", "x" * 100001, 400),
                                ("a" * 200, "x" * 100000, 200)]:
        out = svc.update_document(tok, doc_id, title, content)[0]
        assert out == exp, f"input={(len(title), len(content))!r} output={out!r}"
    doc_id2 = mk(svc, tok, "keep", "keep")
    svc.update_document(tok, doc_id2, "", "zzz")
    s, d = svc.get_document(tok, doc_id2)
    assert d["title"] == "keep" and d["content"] == "keep", f"output={d!r}"


def test_delete_then_everything_is_404_and_hidden():
    """A deleted document gives 404 on get, update, and delete and never appears in list, search, or export."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    keep = mk(svc, tok, "needle keep", "x")
    gone = mk(svc, tok, "needle gone", "x")
    assert svc.delete_document(tok, gone)[0] == 204
    for out in (svc.get_document(tok, gone), svc.update_document(tok, gone, "a", "b"), svc.delete_document(tok, gone)):
        assert out[0] == 404, f"input={gone!r} output={out!r}"
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.list_documents(tok)[1]["items"]] == [keep]

class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; behavior per call set by plan."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}

        self.plan = []  # 'ok' | 'timeout_before' | 'timeout_after'

MISSING = "zzz-missing-id"


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def set(self, t):
        self.t = t

    def advance(self, d):
        self.t += d


class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; mode controls timeouts."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.mode = "ok"      # "ok" | "before" (timeout, no charge) | "after"
        self.calls = []

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charges:
            self.charges[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}


def make(ttl=None, start=1000.0):
    clock = FakeClock(start)
    gw = FakeGateway()
    if ttl is None:
        svc = Service(clock, gw)
    else:
        svc = Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw

        if m is not None:

            if create:
                ids.append(mk_doc(svc, tok, f"late{len(ids)}"))

class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def set(self, t):
        self.t = t

    def advance(self, d):
        self.t += d


class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; mode controls timeouts."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.mode = "ok"      # "ok" | "before" (timeout, no charge) | "after"
        self.calls = []

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charges:
            self.charges[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}
